title: 子句與連接詞
subtitle: Clauses & Conjunctions
summary: 長句之所以難，是因為裡面包了好幾層子句。學會辨認三種子句，長句就能拆成一層一層的積木。

sections.title: 對等連接詞與平行結構

blocks.value: 對等連接詞（and, but, or, nor, for, so, yet）連接文法地位相同的成分。多益常考「平行結構」：連接詞兩邊的詞性、形式必須一致。

items.en: The role requires planning, budgeting, and reporting.
items.zh: 這個職位需要規劃、編列預算與撰寫報告。

items.en: The role requires planning, budgeting, and to report.

rows: not only A but also B

items.en: Neither the manager nor the assistants were informed.
items.zh: 經理與助理都沒被告知。

blocks.q: The training covers not only safety procedures but also _____ techniques.
blocks.explain: not only 之後是名詞片語 safety procedures，but also 之後要平行，用動名詞當形容詞的 troubleshooting techniques。

blocks.value: 名詞子句在句中當主詞、受詞或補語，由 that、whether、if 或疑問詞引導。

rows: 陳述內容（受詞位置可省略）
We believe (that) the plan is sound.
Please confirm whether you can attend.
what / who / when / where / why / how
We don't know when the parts will arrive.

blocks.value: 名詞子句一律用「直述語序」：疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞，不倒裝。

items.en: Could you tell me where the meeting is?
items.zh: 可以告訴我會議在哪裡嗎？
items.note: 不是 where is the meeting

items.en: Whether we proceed depends on the budget.
items.zh: 我們是否進行取決於預算。

blocks.value: whether 可以放介系詞後或接 or not，if 不行：the question of whether…（不能用 if）。

blocks.q: The report does not specify _____ the equipment was inspected.
blocks.explain: 語意是「是否」經過檢查，用 whether 引導名詞子句。

blocks.value: 限定用法不加逗號，關係詞可用 that；非限定用法要加逗號，不能用 that，也不能省略。

items.en: The vendor who submitted the lowest bid was selected.
Our CFO, who joined last year, will lead the audit.
items.zh: 我們的財務長（去年到任）將主導稽核。

items.en: The building that we visited has been renovated.
items.zh: 我們參觀過的那棟大樓已翻新。

blocks.value: 關係子句可以簡化：主動用 V-ing，被動用 p.p.。

items.en: The employees who are working remotely need VPN access.
items.zh: → The employees working remotely need VPN access.

items.en: The report that was submitted yesterday is incomplete.
items.zh: → The report submitted yesterday is incomplete.

blocks.q: The consultant _____ recommendations we adopted has left the firm.
blocks.explain: recommendations 屬於顧問，用所有格關係詞 whose。

rows: when, while, before, after, until, as soon as, once, by the time
if, unless, provided that, as long as, in case
although, though, even though, even if, whereas, while
so + adj. + that, such + N + that

blocks.value: unless = if…not，本身已含否定，不要再加 not。

items.en: Unless the payment clears, we cannot ship the order.
items.zh: 除非款項入帳，否則我們無法出貨。

items.en: The delay was so severe that customers cancelled.
items.zh: 延誤嚴重到客戶取消訂單。

items.en: It was such a severe delay that customers cancelled.

blocks.value: 英文一個句子只能有一個連接詞連接兩個子句。Although…, but… 是中式英文，只能擇一。

blocks.q: _____ the software is updated, users may experience occasional errors.
blocks.explain: 空格後是完整子句，需要連接詞；語意為「直到軟體更新前」，用 Until。

sections.title: 分詞構句：把子句壓縮成片語

blocks.value: 兩個子句主詞相同時，可把副詞子句的主詞與 be 動詞去掉，動詞改成 V-ing（主動）或 p.p.（被動）。

items.en: After he reviewed the contract, he signed it.
items.zh: → After reviewing the contract, he signed it.

items.en: Because it was damaged in transit, the unit was returned.
items.zh: → Damaged in transit, the unit was returned.

items.en: Reviewing the file, the error was discovered.
items.note: 分詞的主詞必須和主句主詞一致，錯誤不會自己審檔案

blocks.value: 多益 Part 5 若空格在句首、後面接逗號與完整主句，答案常是分詞或介系詞片語。

blocks.q: _____ in 1998, the company now operates in over thirty countries.
blocks.explain: 公司是「被創立」，用過去分詞 Founded 引導分詞構句。
